Dielectric properties of lignocellulosic biomass at microwave frequencies for pyrolysis reactor design

Bioresour Technol. 2025 Mar;400:130651. doi: 10.1016/j.biortech.2025.130651

Abstract

We measured the complex permittivity of pine, spruce bark and wheat straw from 25 to 900 °C using the cavity perturbation method at 915 and 2450 MHz. Loss factor rises sharply above 400 °C as carbonisation proceeds, and penetration depth falls below 5 cm, which constrains microwave pyrolysis reactor geometry.
